content:
maria: Quick sync
Were targeting 2026-05-12 10:00am PT for the announcement + rollout. Need changelog link, docs anchor, and rollout cadence by EOD.

alex: We can do progressive rollout: 10% at 09:40, 50% at 09:50, 100% by 10:00 if metrics stable. Ops will hold if p95 > 2x baseline.

tay: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/621
Waiting on final perf sentence from eng.

maria: Marketing needs a one-line headline + one stat for the post. Short and catchy.

alex: Draft: "New batching and cache warmup cut median latency ~24% and lowered cost per 1k tokens ~20%." Ill verify exact numbers and drop into the docs PR.

ops-bot: Release window created: 2026-05-12T17:40:00Z -> 2026-05-12T18:15:00Z. Runbook: /runbooks/release-2026-05-12.

maria: Webinar scheduled Mon 9:00am PT. Need a 2-min perf clip + single-slide summary for the email. Who records?

tay: Alex can record the terminal demo and upload to drive. Ill prep the slide.

salesops: Tag for CRM = "may_release_2026". Please ensure webforms and webinar regs include this hidden field. SLA: 48h for lead follow-up.

alex: Example webhook payload for salesops:

email:user@example.com;name:Pat Example;tags:may_release_2026;source:web_banner

Ill add the middleware to inject the tag and test in staging by tonight.

maria: Changelog owner? Need a single link we can reference in the post.

tay: Changelog PR created: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/134
Will merge once perf blurb and legal sign-off are in. Ill ping when merged.

alex: Bench run done: median 136ms -> 103ms; p95 410ms -> 320ms; cost per 1k tokens $0.49 -> $0.39. Dropping into docs PR now.

ops-bot: Canary started in EU region. Monitor channel: #release-watch. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/90012.

maria: Hold publish until ops gives green at 10:00am PT. Marketing will post social at 10:05 and send email at 10:15.

tay: Docs merged and anchor created: https://docs.redwood.ai/whats-new/2026-05-release.

ops-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic. Post-deploy checks OK.

maria: Publishing now
Thanks all!
